name: Ruddy shelduck
desc: Omnivorous duck of lakes and rivers that eats grasses, shoots, water plants and invertebrates. Breeds in Central Asia from March and April.
about: The ruddy shelduck is a bird species in the family Anatidae. It is a distinctive waterfowl, 58 to 70 cm (23 to 28 in) in length with a wingspan of 110 to 135 cm (43 to 53 in).
